comment: Input slots of the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ModuleV3 stub graph, staged in virtual-device mode (cuda sm_100a). Regenerate with //max/tests/integration/architectures/deepseekV41_modulev3:record_abi_contract, never by hand. The F1 fixture's ABI is recorded separately, in mach/crates/engine-core/tests/testdata/v41_contract.json, which the graph-contract recorder writes in the M3 format the engine's contract test reads.
